results.title: Resurf 2
results.content:
One provider, on purpose. Resurf's AI features lean on tool calls, vision, and transcription, and OpenAI's models handle all three reliably. Resurf 1 supported a whole menu of providers, and it taught me an honest lesson: some models have no vision, some can't transcribe, some fumble tool calls. Every gap surfaced as a feature that mysteriously didn't work. One model that does everything beats five that each do most of it. Other providers will come back gradually, once each one clears the same bar.

This is the direction the app is heading, honestly. Most of us are good at collecting and bad at coming back. Search only helps when you already remember something exists. The interesting problem is the app surfacing the thing you'd forgotten, and that's what I'm building next. [...] Resurf 2 is out. It's not an update to the old app. It's a different app that happens to have the same name and the same idea. Written from scratch in Swift, running natively on Mac, iPhone and iPad, syncing between them through your own iCloud account.

Here's what changed and why.

Resurf on Mac, iPhone and iPad

## Why rewrite it

Resurf 1 was an Electron app. That got the product out of my head and onto people's machines, which was the only thing that mattered at the time. But it came with a ceiling: a slow cold start, a Dock icon that ate memory sitting still, scrolling that never felt right, and no credible path to a phone app. [...] Resurf 1 won't update itself into Resurf 2: different app, different updater. You'll need to download it.

## What's next

The coming weeks are all about polish: fixing the bugs you report and shipping the quality-of-life improvements you submit. Most of what made Resurf 1 better came straight from user messages, and Resurf 2 will work the same way: tell me what's rough, and watch it get fixed.

## Found a bug?

Resurf 2 is a brand-new codebase, and some bugs only show up in the wild, on libraries, Macs, and workflows unlike mine. If something misbehaves, report it or email support@resurf.so. Reports land directly with me, and fixes ship fast.

## Thank you
